theorems.name: Submission.allard52_cft_graph_map_sqrt_two
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)), LipschitzOnWith 1 f D → (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ x' ∈ D, ‖q (graphPoint x (f x)) - q (graphPoint x' (f x'))‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * ‖x - x'‖) ∧ (f 0 = 0 → (0 : Rn n) ∈ D → ∀ x ∈ D, ‖q (graphPoint x (f x))‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * ‖x‖)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
